rules: Resolve the execution-time latest official branch, complete changelogs and production release before every meaningful implementation or promotion pass.
Use one canonical playable identity for proven semantic equivalents; use the verified latest better model, texture, behavior and worldgen implementation together with their dependencies.
Never infer identity from similar titles, filenames or counts. Retain distinct variants and original-only behavior.
Preserve the permanent Nevermine 2.5 Snapshot, AoA-Tslat 1.1.3 and AoA3 3.6.11 historical authorities and all verified Enderloom improvements.
Restore unique historical content absent upstream; an upstream deletion is a reconciliation obligation, not automatic permission to lose content.
Keep registered IDs, save schemas and explicit rename aliases stable. New worldgen applies to new chunks; existing chunk changes require a separate explicit migration with backup and rollback.
Verify existing saves, entity and block-entity data, inventories, travel, multiplayer, optional integrations and equivalent-work performance before promoting changes.
Wiki source checks, local implementation, packaged build, exercised native behavior and complete parity are separate evidence states.
Keep Tslat and contributor attribution, source pins and notices. Do not infer a redistribution waiver from repository write access.
Keep vanilla hearts as the default and retain every optional AoA health display choice.
